plan.key: Decode payload first. JSON array of [shape,fields] blocks. Split fields on ASCII spaces retaining empties. Each shape digit describes one node in preorder: 0=no children, 1=left only, 2=right only, 3=both. Assign fields to nodes in preorder. Read each tree inorder (left,node,right); join all resulting fields with ASCII spaces. Preserve every other character; print only.
